  • Method Details

    • getConvergenceReport

      public OnePhaseFlowConvergenceReport getConvergenceReport()
      Get nonlinear convergence and total-mass diagnostics from the latest pipe solve.

      The returned report is immutable. Before the first solve it has reason OnePhaseFlowConvergenceReport.ConvergenceReason.NOT_RUN.

      Returns:
      latest one-phase convergence report

    • getSpeciesConservationReport

      public OnePhaseSpeciesConservationReport getSpeciesConservationReport()
      Get component inventories, boundary masses, residuals, and boundedness diagnostics.
      Returns:
      latest conservative species report, or a not-run report before opt-in transport

    • getSpeciesConservationHistory

      public OnePhaseSpeciesConservationHistory getSpeciesConservationHistory()
      Get time-aligned diagnostics for every accepted conservative step in the latest transient solve.

      The immutable history is reset at the start of each solveTransient(int, UUID) call. It contains only steps that completed successfully, so a fail-loud solve retains diagnostics for any previously accepted steps. Each report contains component profiles, inventories, boundary masses, residuals, boundedness, and EOS-coupling diagnostics. OnePhaseSpeciesConservationHistory.toJson() provides a stable Python capture path.

      Returns:
      immutable accepted-step history, empty before a conservative transient solve

    • setStoreSpeciesConservationHistory

      public void setStoreSpeciesConservationHistory(boolean store)
      Configure storage of full per-step conservative species diagnostics.

      Storage is off by default to avoid retaining every component-by-cell profile in long simulations. Enabling it does not alter the conservative solve, finite-volume state, or convergence criteria.

      Parameters:
      store - true to retain one immutable report for every accepted conservative step

    • isSpeciesConservationHistoryStorageEnabled

      public boolean isSpeciesConservationHistoryStorageEnabled()
      Check whether full accepted-step species diagnostics are retained.
      Returns:
      true when per-step report storage is enabled

    • setConservativeSpeciesTransport

      public void setConservativeSpeciesTransport(boolean enabled)
      Enable conservative n-1 species transport for transient solver type 1.

      The path is currently isothermal and requires strictly positive flow. Unsupported flow and any failed hydraulic/species criterion throw so that a failed conservative state cannot advance to the next timestep.

      Parameters:
      enabled - true to couple conservative component inventories to hydraulics and EOS

    • isConservativeSpeciesTransportEnabled

      public boolean isConservativeSpeciesTransportEnabled()
      Check whether conservative species transport is enabled.
      Returns:
      true when the opt-in component path is active

    • setSpeciesAdvectionScheme

      public void setSpeciesAdvectionScheme(SpeciesAdvectionScheme scheme)
      Select the finite-volume advection method used by conservative species transport.

      The default remains SpeciesAdvectionScheme.FIRST_ORDER_IMPLICIT. The selected method has no effect unless setConservativeSpeciesTransport(boolean) is enabled.

      Parameters:
      scheme - non-null conservative species advection scheme
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if scheme is null

    • getSpeciesAdvectionScheme

      public SpeciesAdvectionScheme getSpeciesAdvectionScheme()
      Get the selected conservative species advection method.
      Returns:
      non-null typed scheme; first-order implicit by default

    • setAxialDispersionModel

      public void setAxialDispersionModel(AxialDispersionModel model)
      Select a physical axial-dispersion model for conservative component transport.

      Physical dispersion is independent of the selected numerical advection scheme. Use NoAxialDispersion to retain pure advection. The validated boundary conditions are a prescribed inlet composition and zero physical diffusive flux at the outlet.

      Parameters:
      model - non-null physical axial-dispersion model
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if model is null

    • getAxialDispersionModel

      public AxialDispersionModel getAxialDispersionModel()
      Returns:
      selected non-null physical axial-dispersion model

    • setFailOnNonConvergence

      public void setFailOnNonConvergence(boolean failOnNonConvergence)
      Configure whether a transient solve throws when its convergence report fails.

      The default is false for source and behavioral compatibility. Failed convergence is still recorded by getConvergenceReport() and logged as a warning.

      Parameters:
      failOnNonConvergence - true to throw after recording a failed report

    • isFailOnNonConvergence

      Check whether failed transient convergence throws.
      Returns:
      true when strict fail-loud mode is enabled

    • runTransient

      public void runTransient(double totalTime, double timeStep)
      Runs a transient simulation with constant inlet conditions for a specified duration.

      Example: 

       pipe.runTransient(3600.0, 60.0); // 1 hour simulation with 60s time steps
      Parameters:
      totalTime - total simulation time in seconds
      timeStep - time step size in seconds
